Chapter 427 Entering The Holy Product

Inside the Human Emperor Hall.

Mochou looked excited, "Lord of Palace, Lord of Palace!"

In the hall, Wu Hui's figure appeared here. He looked at Mo Chou with an excited face and chuckled, "Mo Chou, why are you so happy?"

Mochou followed him for many years, and was around him when he was not the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace. He was with him day and night, and he was his most trusted subordinate.

Seeing Wu Hui, Mochou said excitedly: "Lord, the deserted city is open!"

"I know."

"The list has also been released in the deserted city. As long as you have the strength, you can make it to the list."

"I know."

Seeing Wu Hui's face calm, Mo Chou stood there in a daze.

At this moment, his expression was so excited that he gradually became a little embarrassed. "Lord of the Palace, you, you already know why you are still indifferent. Can't even the rewards on the combat power list be your eyes?"

Mochou looked puzzled, there were 100 places on the combat power list, and each place was rewarded.

Mo Chou has seen it, and even the reward of No. 100 makes him very popular, not to mention the legendary treasures that rank high.

Now the people on the list are all people with names but no real ones, and he can be on him.

He could not see those treasures being acquired by others.

Looking at Mo Chou who was anxious, Wu Hui smiled and explained, "Mo Chou, have you forgotten? The rule is to get rewards every week. Now that the list has only been released for half a day, why should you be anxious?"

Hearing Wu Hui's words, Mo Chou was slightly stunned and asked, "District Master, what do you mean is, wait until the end?"

Wu Hui laughed but said nothing.

Seeing this, Mo Chou understood, he was really confused.

If I rushed over to play the rankings now, wouldn’t it seem that their Human Emperor Palace has no signs?

Experts often appear in the end.

However, this is just because the Human Emperor Palace is extremely powerful in the Chaos Realm, and few opponents can think so.

The top powers in the remaining forces are just the opposite.

They must go to the rankings now so that their power can be revealed in the world.

And if they make the rankings later, the ones who compete with them for rankings will be a terrifying opponent like the Human Emperor Palace.

At that time, they would even become stepping stones for the strong to ascend to the ascension of the strong.

And if they are on the list now, their names will be at the top of the list at least in a short period of time.

Although the final outcome was still being stomped down by the last strong man, they were at least glorious.

Meanwhile, in the deserted city square.

Everyone looked at the combat power list and shouted in shock.

The vast ancestor at the top of the combat power list, facing the challenge of the Supreme Human Race Chen Wei, he actually successfully defended the list!

Seeing this scene, the Supreme Elder of the Dark River widened his eyes and couldn't believe it. He rubbed his eyes hard, stared at the Haohan Ancestor who was still the first place on the list, and said in a lost voice: "Isn't this?" possible!"

He has fought both of them, and it is a life-and-death challenge. He has the most say in which one is stronger.

He tried his best and didn't even want his life. He could injure the ancestor Haohan, but he couldn't hurt Chen Wei.

With such a gap in strength, how could the ancestor Haohan defeat Chen Wei?

What's even more terrifying is that the successful predecessor of Haohan Ancestor means that he not only defeated Chen Wei, but killed Chen Wei!

Unbelievable.

What exactly is the problem?

Elder Dark River racked his brains and grabbed his hair, and finally guessed a possibility.

"Can you say that there will be any combat power bonus for this top list? No, no, I was the top list too, it's useless. The Great Ancestor Hidden Power?"

"Yes, that must be the case."

"Damn it, he actually hid so deeply. In his eyes, I was probably as ridiculous as a clown."

The Supreme Elder of the Dark River had a bitter smile and sat down on the ground in a daze.

How could he know that the top spot that he would get the elixir against the sky?

Similarly, Chen Wei, who was resurrected, was still confused after being confused. He actually lost and even died in battle.

His dignified human powerhouse has never beaten the ancestor Haohan.

However, after recovering, he quickly understood that the vast ancestor had entered the realm of the Supreme Heavenly Supreme when he had entered the realm of the holy grade heaven.

The Supreme of the Holy Grade Heaven!

Even if it is placed in the human race, it is one of the few strong people.

It’s not unfair to lose yourself.

Looking up at the combat power list again, Chen Wei clenched his fists, looking unwilling.

Because he does not represent himself, but the face of the human race.

What kind of face does he have to face his fellow humans?

In the square, many human races looked dissatisfied with Chen Wei's defeat to Haohan Ancestor.

They really wanted to question it loudly, but when they thought that this was Huangcheng. Not to mention it was inside Huangcheng, even if they were outside, they would not dare to question Huangcheng.

However, it was very impossible for them to believe that the Great Ancestor could defeat Chen Wei.

And at this moment, the space blew slightly, and a figure appeared, which immediately attracted the attention of the audience.

The vast ancestor!

At this moment, the vast ancestor was covered in spring breeze and the scenery was infinite. He smiled and enjoyed this temporary sense of victory.

When the pills were in his mouth, he felt a transformation in his body. As he completely refined the remaining essence of the pills, he even made a breakthrough, his cultivation level increased, and he successfully reached the ranks of the Supreme Holy Class Heaven.

I have to say that his luck is really good.

Of course, luck and strength are indispensable.

If he had not defeated the top elder of the Dark River, the then top elder, perhaps the person who obtained the pill would be the Dark River, the Dark River.

At this moment, the Great Ancestor did not hide at all, and released the breath of his holy grade Supreme Heaven. This breath had no deterrence, just like the spring breeze floating, but the sense of oppression came from people's hearts.

The countless strong men present knew that, and the unsatisfied human powerhouses also closed their mouths.

The Holy Pin Heaven Supreme can really convince the public if it can top the list when the list is just released.

The ancestor Haohan also showed off his might and then left the scene.

He didn't dare to put down any harsh words, and said something like who else was there.

He knew very well that those real strong men just didn't want to show up so early.

The most urgent task is to find a place to stabilize the state.

After all, he has just made a breakthrough, but it is worth mentioning that fighting Chen Wei’s life-and-death battle has greatly helped him to his stable realm.

And just as he left the square, a figure came to him.

"Ancestor Haohan, please stay."

"Um?"

The ancestor Haohan frowned slightly. At this time, someone dared to stop him.

He looked at the phantom in front of him and frowned slightly, "Who are you?"

The phantom nodded slightly and said, "The person in charge of the combat power list in Xiahuang City, I will tell you that the people on the list will have a special place to rest and retreat."

As he said that, a token was handed over to the hands of the ancestor Haohan.
